topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Hearing that my best friend is moving across the country, I've been thinking a lot. It's strange, how the mind works, jumping through memories like a flipbook, each page a snapshot of us. I've been looking at the map, tracing the distance with my finger, wondering what it's like over there. There’s a part of me that’s plotting visits, road trips, and surprise meetups, finding adventures in the miles that lie between us. It feels like this move isn’t just changing our geography but also reigniting our spirits. I guess, in a way, it’s showing us that no distance can truly come between us, and that's a pretty powerful thing to realize.
